title: Invariant factors from products of cyclotomic polynomials, with applications
summary: Let $f,g\in\mathbb{Z}[t]$ be products of cyclotomic polynomials such that either $g/\gcd(f,g)$ or $f/\gcd(f,g)$ (or both) is squarefree. We give explicit formulae for the invariant factors of $f(C_g)$, where $C_g$ is the companion matrix of $g$, expressing them in terms of the indices and multiplicities of the cyclotomic factors of $f$ and $g$. A more compact formula holds for the circulant case $g(t)=t^n-1$, assuming that every cyclotomic factor shared by $f$ and $g$ has multiplicity $1$ in $f$.
